notes.title: Ver 1.3.2 Update: Improved Bullet Visibility
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/b7404362042bcf4d9849fa8cefb8a899a9ba5114.jpg

After several months of experimenting and borrowing what I learnt from my other shoot'em up Yellow Trouble, I have finally found a set of color changes that improve enemy bullet visibility across the 10 stages without needing to dull or dim the backgrounds, all while still retaining the yellow-red or blue-red combinations.

This should boost overall survivability, especially for those having a harder time differentiating between two elevations.

notes.title: Ver 1.3.1 Update: Cat C & D Buff
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/987855846feae2d94ed7795f63f5fee88d7e272a.jpg

This update increases the damage of the two bonus helicopters, Cat C and Cat D (as seen in the No Miss Cat D video),. Both of them require some getting used to in order to reach their full potential. But it should be evident quite quickly how high their DPS can be at max level.

To unlock Cat C, get the Victory Is and Illusion objective by getting Ending A after beating the mission 8 boss. This can be done with Novice Mode (regardless of continues) or Arcade Mode (must use a continue and have a cumulative destroy rate below 80%). To unlock Cat D, get the Hungry for Napalm objective by obtaining at least 13 additional bomb drops in a run (continues are allowed).

Some changes were made to the backend graphics rendering as well and should improve the performance on lower spec machines. If you have a high refresh rate monitor, the game should have little trouble hitting that stable rate.

Ver 1.3.1 Update Notes:

 Increased the damage of Cat C's angled sub shots. When aiming completely straight ahead with the main shot, the total DPS at max level is the highest in the game.
 Increased the damage of Cat D's missile sub weapon. The missiles hit BOTH air and ground targets without needing to change elevation. At max level, together with the main shot, Cat D's forward DPS is just slightly lower than Cat C's.
 Changed the rendering backend to improve performance on non-ancient machine specs.

notes.title: Major Update Ver 1.3.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/97295ddab16c8d6276f0f5c2570291615be2eb49.jpg

Heli-Cats's third major update is here with changes that aim to give the player a slight edge on the battlefield, several quality of life improvements, and better compatibility for those of us on macOS!

Version 1.3.0 Notes:

 Added a 5-frame window to the player helicopter for split second emergency bombing before a hit is registered.
 Slightly reduced the collision size of enemy bullets to allow for more leniency.
 Added a "Restart Run" option in the pause menu and single player continue screen to instantly redo a run from mission 1, which also counts the previous run for Steam leaderboards up to that point.
 Using a "Restart Run" with armor mods active will deduct any armor lost from the current run for the new run if it is still above 3. (e.g. An initial run with 30 armor mods that restarts after losing 5 armor will begin the new run with 25.) The new run will never be lower than the default 3 armor.
 Boss mid-battle explosions that signal major damage to the boss now also destroy all enemy bullets for a brief period, allowing a window to reposition or escape a difficult barrage.
 Added an "Armor Bonus" message that appears when getting an extend every 400,000 points.
 Added a "Time's Up" message that appears when running out of time on a boss.
 Destroying a hidden beacon sends out a visual shockwave that will remove all enemy bullets on screen (more on what beacons are in a later post...).
 Added an option in Display Settings to turn off "How To Play" before starting arcade mode.
 Increased the maximum system credits that can be unlocked beyond 9.
 More native compatibility for game controllers on macOS Sequoia (Steam Input should still be disabled on macOS due to Steam Input being recognized as a duplicate controller).
 Added another attract demonstration screen for mission 2 that will show after leaving the title screen untouched (for those of us who have this running on an arcade cabinet).


NOTE: This update is also a major change in the underlying architecture of the game for modern operating systems.
* If you have remapped your controls before, you will need to remap them again in the Options > Controls Menu. *
Otherwise, this revision should not affect the experience for users. In fact, it should run better for those on macOS. This revamp of the game allows me to continually add more updates going forward whenever I discover development tricks with my other newer games. However, if you encounter any strange behavior, crashes, or difficulty running it on an ancient machine, please report it. Thank you.

If you haven't played Heli-Cats in a while, try version 1.3 out! And if you have it in your wishlist, perhaps it's time to get the game!

notes.title: Ver 1.2.1 Update (More Credits)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/05a2bab7eb51b44c358fd23ad2379cc60854b7c3.jpg

This update increases the credits received when players reach any ending across all difficulties, with higher difficulties granting even more. This should incentivize players to credit feed to the end in order to learn the layout of the later missions. The credits received for completing the game should compensate for the added credits needed to beat it.

The non-1CC entry criteria for mission 9 has also been reduced from a cumulative destroy rate of 90% to 80%. Players will still need to be aggressive when credit feeding, but it should be doable with familiarity of the missions. Beating mission 8 without continuing in Arcade difficulty or higher will always grant entry to mission 9 regardless of destroy rate.

Time to get back to the battlefield and complete those objectives!

Ver 1.2.1 Update Notes:

 Increased the amount of credits received upon reaching an ending across all difficulties.
 Reduced the cumulative destroy rate needed to enter mission 9 with continues from 90% to 80%.
 Fixed an exploit in team play that allows entry into mission 9.

notes.title: Major Update Ver 1.2.0 (Novice Mode + More Credits Earned)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/67236dd43e0b6e85d6a866b91bdb6f968095da5e.jpg

Heli-Cats's second major update adds Novice Mode and increases the amount of user credits earned!

Novice Mode is an easier difficulty that is tuned for those new to shoot'em ups.
Press up at Arcade Mode to select it. It is much easier than Arcade Mode and does not have a rank difficulty increase, but players still cannot sleepwalk their way through in the later missions. It cannot access Mission 9, secret items. nor qualify for the 1CC achievement. There is also no leaderboard for Novice Mode. Players can still earn credits for every mission cleared, although these missions won't show up in Training Mode. Only Arcade Mode mission clears count for those. Use it to learn the layout of the 8 main missions and enjoy the dual-elevation gameplay.

User credits earned has been increased based on difficulty.
Players can earn more user credits based on the difficulty selected and ending attained. Endings A and B earn an additional 3 credits on Arcade and above, while endings C and D earn 5 more. Also, Another Mode doubles the amount of earned credits. Players should find the ramp up in earned credits helpful in pushing towards the higher difficulties. Together with Assisted 1CC, everyone can definitely get every objective in the game!

If you haven't played Heli-Cats in a while, give Novice Mode a go! And if you have it in your wishlist, perhaps it's time to get the game!

notes.title: Major Update Ver 1.1.0 (Rebalancing + Upgrades)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/9e30ac3d11a18f5ed76fe007f984a08e4969787b.jpg

Heli-Cats's first major update changes the enemy aggression ramp in Arcade Mode. Enemy firepower has been tamed significantly in the earlier missions as follows.

Missions 1 - 3: Enemy shot speed and reload timings have been slowed down greatly.
Missions 4 - 6: The same parameters above have been slowed down moderately.
Missions 7 and above: No change.

Experienced players may find the earlier missions too easy, but will now have the flexibility to explore riskier strategies while also having more room for error.
Even beginners can try staying at level 1 in these missions to see if they can handle it while seeing the score go up a lot more. Achieving a score of 200,000+ in mission 1 is very doable for average players now.

Cat B's damage output has been increased across all levels.
This buff further emphasizes how Cat B's accuracy and speed rewards faster destruction. If you've been using Cat A for the safety of the wide shot, you may want to give Cat B a spin to see the difference. Cat B favors a more methodical play style instead of relying on blind firing.

The helicopter cockpit now has a glowing effect when active.
This change aims to help players learn the hit box of the helicopter and get used to the large area. It should further illustrate that this game does not play like a bullet hell and use of the elevation change is always safer than squeezing through barrages.

Give the new changes a try and see if you can get past your previous wall! Will this update produce the first Arcade Mode 1CC?

notes.title: Ver 1.0.3 Update (Power Level 3 Enhancement)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/dcdf8fb39e3bbce99c66ea8fafe704ec8d57f6a2.jpg

This update aims to help players who find Heli-Cats's power up resource system too stressful to manage. All Cat types now have more level 3 normal shots available. Orbs also refill the meter more. Basically, there is no need to keep refilling with orbs as often, allowing players to explore and better understand the relationship of the different shots.

This changes the flow of the game depending on how one plays.

Those who are getting better with the mechanics should find maintaining level 3 in missions and during boss encounters much more relaxed. Shot discipline is still very important and players holding auto fire constantly will not see as much benefit. Check out the Focus Shot post below to learn how it works in detail. The focus shot is not just for getting orbs. Learning how to alternate the shots brings out the full potential of the helicopters.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262880/view/3893986782131016961

Players going for score will now have to be aware of the longer time it takes to power down from level 3. Taking risks and deliberately staying at a low level will still yield the greatest scores, but that is really for advanced players.

Overall, everyone should be able to progress further with the increased survivability.

Ver 1.0.3 Update Notes:

 Increased the amount of level 3 normal shots available across all Cat types.
 Increased the orb refill amounts for level 3.

notes.title: Training Mode Bosses Added (0.9.5 Update)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/ba677ac5185691871ac65b361913df57bbab9ff8.jpg

This update adds the mission bosses to Training mode. Individual bosses will be unlocked only after clearing them in Arcade mode, either by destroying or timing out.

Bosses will start at the highest mission rank cap, while the focus counter is set to 1000. Training mode bosses represent the hardest possible form they can take, meaning that their versions in Arcade mode is most likely less difficulty since players will normally not be at max rank unless they are already doing an advanced skill scoring run.

Use Training mode's unlimited armor to find a strategy that works without worrying about getting hit, or try changing the player power level to see if a lower level is also doable.

notes.title: Advanced Display Settings Added (0.9.4 Update)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/6264ff94081c4c95c0da1e316b2bdc44500c3827.jpg

This update adds advanced settings in the display options. The defaults usually work for most players, but they are provided to give choices based on personal preferences and hardware.

STRETCH MODE - This setting was previously available and is mainly used to change the way the game scales in size on non-standard screen and window resolutions. If in full screen using a 1080, 1440, or 2160 screen, there will be no difference. On a 768 screen, for example, using Pixel Perfect will reduce the game to a smaller size based on an integer multiple of 360 (with black borders or wallpaper around it). To see this in effect, disable full screen, resize the window, then toggle this setting. It should also be visible on the Steam Deck's native resolution.

BULLET COLOR - The official way to play this game is to use red bullets for low elevation and yellow bullets for high. All art direction was based off of this combination. The Alternate color changes the high elevation from yellow to blue. The player helicopter, player bullets, and all air enemies also change their respective colors accordingly. It is provided as an option for those struggling with the default and is aimed at helping those coming from bullet hell games such as those by Cave. However, it may not shorten the the learning curve this game has. Do note that monitor settings such as saturation and contrast have a big effect on the appearance of colors as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/83671f1ac2bfe56eee63d2f1fbaea8b01120a7c4.jpg

VSYNC - Having this enabled makes the game attempt to match the refresh rate of the monitor. It is only useful with monitors above 60Hz and may make the game look smoother on such screens.

LOCKED 60 FPS - Having this enabled locks the game at 60 fps. If VSync is enabled, this is usually set to off, and vice versa. Locking it to 60 makes the game use less CPU than a higher rate and may improve performance on lower end machines. If enabled, it is advisable to lower a high refresh rate monitor down to the locked 60Hz in order to avoid choppy movement.

(Note to macOS users: Using VSync On and Locked 60 FPS Off is recommended for Ventura and above.)

notes.title: Version 0.9.3 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43572316/5e3c718688e9af3ac09ec63f85ed0e2f8e88c7d9.jpg

This update brings the game closer to a release state with a score rebalancing that helps both beginners to survive and motivates skilled players to take on more risk. It also adds faster ways to skip non-mission sections.

Version 0.9.3 Update Notes:

 Reduced the armor extend score to every 400,000. This significantly changes the extend timings and allows average players to earn the first extend much sooner while also granting multiple extends per run to skilled players aiming for score. Getting an extend while armor is full gives a 100,000 score bonus, meaning it only takes another 300,000 for the next extend.
 Increased the score bonus of the energy tanks in mission 5.
 Getting hit from the third time onwards in Trial Mode incurs a no score, no focus counter penalty for a cooldown period, preventing point blanking while exploiting unlimited armor.
 Pressing start will completely skip mission briefings and mission complete dialogue, instead of advance the dialogue. The shot, elevation, and bomb buttons will still just advance it.
 Holding start during mid-mission dialogue will fast forward the game until the dialogue ends.
